values.meaning: Heal on hitting an enemy champion or monster
values.quote: heals for 50% of the {{as|health cost}}, increased to 100% against {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|monsters}}

mechanics.claim: The bonesaw deals magic damage only to the first enemy it hits, then stops.
mechanics.quote: throws an infected bonesaw in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit

mechanics.claim: Damage has a flat minimum threshold and a separate lower cap when hitting monsters.
mechanics.quote: ''Infected Bonesaw'' has a minimum damage threshold, and is capped against {{tip|monsters}}.

mechanics.claim: Hitting an enemy champion or monster refunds the full health cost as a heal to Dr. Mundo; other targets (e.g. minions) only refund half.
mechanics.quote: If the bonesaw hits an enemy, '''Dr. Mundo''' {{tip|heals}} for 50% of the {{as|health cost}}, increased to 100% against {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|monsters}}.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocking the ability's damage/slow on the enemy still allows Dr. Mundo to receive the health cost refund.
mechanics.quote: Spell shield blocking the ability's effects on the enemy does not prevent Dr. Mundo from receiving the health cost refund.
